test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Archaeologist R Nagaswamy, who passed away in January 2022, is known for his archival research on temple inscriptions and art history of which place?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **R. Nagaswamy**

 
 
• The **son of Sanskrit scholar Ramachandran Sastrigal**, archaeologist **R. Nagaswamy was born on August 10, 1930**.
 
• Nagaswamy completed his **PhD** from the **University of Poona** in both **art and archaeology**.
 
• He received training in archaeology from the **Archaeological Survey of India (ASI)**.
 
• In **1959 **he began working as the **curator of art and archaeology** at the **Government Museum in Chennai**.
 
• Ramachandran Nagaswamy, **an Indian historian, archaeologist, and epigraphist**, lived from **10 August 1930 to 23 January 2022**.
 
• He is most recognised for his research on **Tamil Nadu's temple** inscriptions and art history.
 
• He had extensive knowledge of **Chola bronzes**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In **1966**, Nagaswamy was appointed the **first director of the Tamil Nadu Archaeology Department**, a position he held until **1988**.
 
• In **1980**, he also started the yearly **Chidambaram Natyanjali event**.
 
• He received the **Padma Bhushan**, India's third-highest civilian honour, in 2018.
 
• The Tamil Nadu government honoured Nagaswamy with the **Kalaimamani award **for his contribution to **Sekkilar's Periyapuranam**.
 
• Through the distribution of **pocket book guides**, he made **archaeology a popular subject in Tamil Nadu**, especially among kids.
